rationale: X accurately traces lookup from mutable `LookupContext` details through interned `TemplateDetails::Requested` keys, prefix-major `PathSet` traversal, resolver ranking, and locals binding. It handles every requested edge case with the externally visible template order, identity behavior, miss result, or assignment error, and its important distinction between direct per-call formats and render-level JS fallback is more precise than a superficial source walkthrough. Although X inspected rather than executed the relevant tests, its claims were confirmed by the focused Action View test files, so it is at least at reference quality with no material correctness error.

shortcomings.summary: The transcript does not execute the focused tests it relies on.
shortcomings.evidence: X.thread.md lines 64-770 show extensive `rg` and `sed` inspection of implementation and test files but no `bin/test` invocation. Judge verification with `actionview/bin/test test/template/lookup_context_test.rb test/template/resolver_shared_tests.rb test/template/file_system_resolver_test.rb test/template/testing/fixture_resolver_test.rb test/template/render_test.rb` completed with 624 runs, 2177 assertions, 0 failures, and 0 errors.

strengths.summary: It correctly separates mutable lookup state from cache-key and resolver-cache state.
strengths.evidence: X.md lines 26-47 and 117-141 match actionview/lib/action_view/lookup_context.rb lines 57-82 and 114-139, actionview/lib/action_view/template_details.rb lines 5-24, and actionview/lib/action_view/template/resolver.rb lines 156-181. It accurately explains copy-on-write details, interned Requested objects, cache-disabled nil keys, virtual-path unbound caching, and locals-bound Template caching.

strengths.summary: Its format normalization analysis captures the non-obvious differences among setters, constructors, direct find options, and full rendering.
strengths.evidence: X.md lines 49-66 and 89-97 align with actionview/lib/action_view/lookup_context.rb lines 200-212 and 258-303, actionview/lib/action_view/template.rb lines 204-212, and actionview/lib/action_view/base.rb lines 326-337. This supports the stated `[:js, :html]` setter fallback, `Mime::ALL` expansion, assignment-time invalid-format error, constructor/direct-find behavior, and render-level JS fallback.

strengths.summary: It provides complete, source-backed observable outcomes for ordering, partials, locals, and cache modes.
strengths.evidence: X.md lines 68-119 correctly describes prefix-outer/resolver-inner first-hit behavior, format-locale-variant-handler ranking, locale and variant result ordering, underscored partial paths, locals-independent file selection, strict-locals reuse, and cache-on/off object identity. These behaviors are established by actionview/lib/action_view/path_set.rb lines 40-72, actionview/lib/action_view/template_details.rb lines 36-60, actionview/lib/action_view/template/resolver.rb lines 165-247, and actionview/lib/action_view/unbound_template.rb lines 21-107.
